sparkline.$description: Sparkline: a chart the size of a word, in a line of text or a row of a table.

color.$description: The line, the area and the bars.

rise.$description: A win, as a bar up.

fall.$description: A loss, as a bar down.

area-opacity.$description: How strong the fill under the line is.

bar-radius.$description: The corners at the end of a bar.

marker-size.$description: The size of a dot on a marked value.

marker-ring.$description: The ring in the color behind it.

reference-width.$description: The width of the reference line.

root.$description: The sparkline: `color` paints its reference line.
